recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. The core RDF page now agrees with the applied external generator behavior; no additional checked-in core source changes were found for generated Turtle examples.
issue_request: FHIR-49834 was Applied/Persuasive for R6 by ITS and asked that generated FHIR RDF examples type narrative xhtml div literals as rdf:XMLLiteral rather than plain strings or xsd:string values.
initial_application: No FHIR specification repository commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-49834. The Jira-requested generator fix was applied in the external HAPI org.hl7.fhir.core Turtle generator by hapifhir/org.hl7.fhir.core#1854, merged 2025-02-07. The local FHIR source already had rdf:XMLLiteral wording and an rdf:XMLLiteral fhir:div example in source/rdf.html, but a nearby paragraph still contradicted them by saying XHTML was escaped xsd:string.
additional_context: source/rdf.html is linked by current core documentation/navigation source. The Device example named by the Jira is current build input through the active Device resource and genomicstudy example list, but generated Turtle examples are not checked into this FHIR source tree. ITS minutes for 2025-03-12 record approval of FHIR-49834 by DB/BP 4-0-0, and the community searches found no conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Changed source/rdf.html to say XHTML is represented as escaped markup with datatype rdf:XMLLiteral, eliminating the stale xsd:string guidance while leaving the existing rdf:XMLLiteral datatype text and example intact.
source_changes: source/rdf.html: replaced the stale statement that XHTML is represented as escaped xsd:string with wording that uses rdf:XMLLiteral.
